criteria.title: Compose runtime, transaction and block interfaces without bypassing ownership layers.
criteria.task: Draw the full bytecode→named service→store→page adapter→syscall→virtio path, with ownership and error translation at every edge. Verify the adapter confines pages to[16,83) and uses caller-owned workspace.
criteria.purpose: Composition can bypass a lower-layer authority or silently change failure guarantees.

deliverables.D1: Prediction and causal explanation addressing: Composition can bypass a lower-layer authority or silently change failure guarantees.
deliverables.D2: Draw the full bytecode→named service→store→page adapter→syscall→virtio path, with ownership and error translation at every edge. Verify the adapter confines pages to[16,83) and uses caller-owned workspace.
